s: Hello and welcome to Word Kitchen.
Today we talk about school things.
Yes, five small words: book, pen, pencil, notebook, and bag.
These words live in every classroom.
I read a book every morning with tea.
I read a book before bed.
A good book is my friend.
Yesterday I bought a new book at the shop.
It is a small book, only one hundred pages.
I write with a blue pen.
Lena, what color is your pen?
I always have a pen in my pocket.
At work, I use a pen all day.
Yesterday my pen ran out of ink, so I bought a new pen.
A pencil is also for writing, but with a pencil you can erase.
A short pencil is in my bag right now.
You carry a pencil in your bag?
My bag is full of school things.
My bag has a book, a pen, and a pencil.
It is a big red bag.
In my bag I have one notebook.
A notebook has clean white pages.
I write my ideas in a notebook.
I open my notebook and write a new word in it.
Let us review the five words.
Every morning I take my bag.
I put my book in the bag.
I put my pen in the bag.
I put my pencil in the bag.
And my notebook goes in the bag too.
But I am ready for school.
At school I open my book.
The teacher speaks, and I write fast.
With my pencil I draw a small house.
The house has a door and a window.
So today: a book for reading, a pen for writing, a pencil for drawing, a notebook for your ideas, and a bag to carry them all.
Then say the words out loud: book, pen, pencil, notebook, bag.
Write the words in your notebook.
Your notebook is your best teacher.
And put that notebook in your bag.
Then your bag has everything you need.
Next time we learn five new words.
